# Next.js PWA Project

This is a Next.js 14+ project with PWA capabilities.

## Tech Stack
- Next.js 14+ with App Router
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- PWA support via next-pwa
- ApexCharts for data visualization
- WebSocket client (ws)
- Vercel Postgres for database

## Development Guidelines
- Use App Router patterns (app directory)
- Follow TypeScript best practices
- Use Tailwind CSS for styling
- Components should be in `/components` directory
- API routes should be in `/app/api` directory

## PWA Features
- Service worker for offline support
- Manifest for installable app
- Caching strategies configured in next.config.js
